description: The display carve-out tests of vLLM patch 0030, run from the candidate image's own vLLM tree with the serving container's DRM access: vocabulary-sized weights are created in their own carve-out buffers and load in place without touching ordinary memory, small and non-CUDA weights stay ordinary, the post-load confirmation accepts weights loaded in place and refuses a weight outside the carve-out or a buffer left behind by a dropped layer, and the debug integrity check still baselines every carve-out weight.
